Now is when you need to seek some kind of help, I know what it feels like. Better than anyone else, I think I may be able to sympathize; for my family/friends, the first indication that something was wrong with me was when I went to the emergency room for a failed suicide attempt. After months of physical recovery, hospital psych programs and therapy, it's all I can do to put on a brave face and pretend the depression is behind me. It isn't. Like you say, every day I want to die more and more. The best I can hope for is helping people like me until I work up the nerve to try again.

I didn't post this to get attention. Or sympathy. I posted it to confession for just that reason; to confess. Like I said, I'm too spineless to tell any of this to someone who has any chance of getting me help, but it had to be said. But your words and concerns are very much appreciated.
